title: Trade-In Agreements: Condition Grade Standards and Offer Valuation
content:
Every written offer under **Trade-In Agreements** is issued for one vehicle at one of six condition grades, from lowest to highest: Inoperable Condition Offer, Rough Condition Offer, Fair Condition Offer, Good Condition Offer, Very Good Condition Offer and Excellent Condition Offer. The grade sets the offer amount and every grade-dependent term of the agreement.

## 1. Entry standards by grade

A vehicle is written at a grade whose entry standard it meets. A dash means the grade's standard sets nothing on that point.

| Entry standard | Inoperable | Rough | Fair | Good | Very Good | Excellent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starts and drives | No: does not start, cannot be driven safely, or has flood or fire damage | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Dashboard warning lights | — | Allowed | Allowed | Not allowed | Not allowed | Not allowed |
| Damaged panels | — | No limit | At most 4 | At most 2 | At most 1 | None |
| Frame damage | — | Allowed | Not allowed | — | — | — |
| Tire tread on every tire | — | — | — | At least 4/32 in | At least 5/32 in | At least 6/32 in |
| Accident history | — | — | — | — | None with structural damage | None reported |
| Keys or fobs | — | — | — | — | — | 2 |
| Branded title | Allowed | Allowed | Not allowed | Not allowed | Not allowed | Not allowed |

## 2. Grade value factor and rounding

The offer is a percentage of the Good-condition valuation of the same vehicle, and the offer amount is rounded **down** to the grade's rounding increment.

| Grade | Grade value factor (percent of the Good-condition valuation) | Rounding increment (offers rounded down to) |
|---|---|---|
| Inoperable Condition Offer | 35 | $25.00 |
| Rough Condition Offer | 60 | $25.00 |
| Fair Condition Offer | 82 | $25.00 |
| Good Condition Offer | 100 | $25.00 |
| Very Good Condition Offer | 106 | $25.00 |
| Excellent Condition Offer | 112 | $25.00 |

A regraded offer is the current offer multiplied by the new grade's value factor and divided by the current grade's value factor; it is rounded down to the same increment.

## 3. Illustration (hypothetical figures)

A vehicle with a hypothetical Good-condition valuation of $14010.00 written at the Fair Condition Offer grade: 82 percent of $14010.00 is $11488.20, and rounding down to the $25.00 increment gives an offer of **$11475.00**. Written at the Good Condition Offer grade, the same valuation gives $14000.00 after rounding down.

## 4. Points of reading

- **Is the factor applied to the vehicle's own grade valuation?** No. Every grade's factor is a percentage of the Good-condition valuation of the same vehicle.
- **Is an offer ever rounded up?** No. Offers and regraded offers are rounded down to the $25.00 increment.
